title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) was sidelined at Denver's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: A foot injury has left Mims sidelined at practice all week. It may very well leave him inactive for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, but his potential absence wouldn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian O'Neill (knee) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Brian O'Neill (knee) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: O'Neill was limited at the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday, but he was downgraded to a non-participant on Thursday, which is a bad sign for his availability for Week 2. If he is ruled out, Minnesota's offensive front will be weaker than usual against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Van Ginkel (chest) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Andrew Van Ginkel (chest) was a limited participant at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: A chest injury has left the veteran limited at two-straight practices to start the week. It looks more likely than not that he will play in Week 2, which would be great for Minnesota's defense ahead of what projects to be a tough matchup against Chicago's red-hot offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Cashman (wrist) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Blake Cashman (wrist) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Cashman was upgraded to a full participant at Thursday's practice after being limited by a wrist injury on Wednesday. He should play this week, which is good news for Minnesota's defense ahead of a tough matchup against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jauan Jennings (personal) absent from another practice Thursday
items.desc: Jauan Jennings (personal) was absent from another practice on Thursday.
items.impact: A personal issue of some kind left Jennings absent from a second-straight practice on Thursday. It's currently unclear whether or not it will affect his availability for Week 2, but he isn't fantasy relevant at this point in the season, so his injury status doesn't carry much weight for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyler Murray (concussion) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Kyler Murray (concussion) was a limited participant at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Murray is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and remained limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday as a result. It seems like he's trending the right way for Week 2, but even if he's cleared to play in time, the team might decide to play it safe and let him sit out for another week, which would give Carson Wentz another start on Sunday. This is a situation that fantasy managers should be monitoring over the next couple of days.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DJ Giddens (knee) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: DJ Giddens (knee) was absent from Indianapolis' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Giddens is a new addition to Indianapolis' injury report. He has been added because of a knee injury that he's dealing with, and it looks like he could miss Sunday's game because of it. He is currently nothing more than a depth RB for the Colts, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't read too much into his injury status for Sunday night's game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) returned to practice as a full participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Richardson returned to the practice field on Thursday after missing Wednesday's practice due to a groin injury. He was a full participant and it looks like he should be fully healthy heading into the weekend, though he will continue to be just the QB2 on this offense behind Daniel Jones for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Alec Pierce (heel) officially did not take part in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Surprisingly, Pierce was a non-participant at the team's second practice of the week on Thursday. He's only listed with the same heel issue that has been bothering him for months, so it remains unclear if this is a load management move by the team or if he actually aggravated the injury to some degree. This is a situation worth monitoring heading into the weekend, as Josh Downs and Keenan Allen will both see more work than usual if the Colts are without their apparent WR1 this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keenan Allen (rest) full participant Thursday
items.desc: Keenan Allen (rest) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran was a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. The team was simply limiting his workload as a load management tactic, and he should be fully good to go for Week 2. He may see more work than usual if Alec Pierce (heel) or Ashton Dulin (ankle) are sidelined against Kansas City.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Dulin (ankle) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin (ankle) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Dulin is trending towards being sidelined in Week 2 due to the ankle injury that he's managing. Alec Pierce (heel) is also risk of being sidelined for Sunday night's game, so these injuries may lead to more involvement for Keenan Allen and Josh Downs against the Chiefs this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Jones (calf) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Chris Jones (calf) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kansas City's star defensive lineman continues to be limited at practice due to a nagging calf injury. It looks unlikely to affect his availability for Week 2, but we won't know for sure until sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) practices in full again Thursday
items.desc: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie should be good to go for Sunday night's game against the Colts, despite suffering a shoulder injury last week. He has been a full participant at practice all week and will likely be without an injury designation heading into the weekend, barring any setbacks with his recovery.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Josh Simmons (back) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Simmons is going to be sidelined for another game in Week 2, as he was still a non-participant in the team's practice on Thursday. It looks like rookie Kahlil Benson will once again get the starting nod in his place, which is fine because he looked great in his NFL debut against a tough Broncos defense last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brandin Cooks works out with Ravens
items.desc: Brandin Cooks worked out with the Ravens on Thursday.
items.impact: The Ravens brought in the 32-year old for an official workout on Thursday. This comes in light of the fact that they may be without their top wideout for a short period of time, with Zay Flowers (hamstring) likely to be sidelined for a week or two at least. The workout ended without a deal for Cooks, but we could possibly see him join the team sometime within the next few weeks if they continue to need help at the wide receiver position.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Samaje Perine (illness) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Samaje Perine (illness) did not take part in Cincinnati's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran running back is a new addition to the injury report, being listed with an illness that left him sidelined at practice on Thursday. He's likely considered day-to-day for the time being, but in the off-chance that he doesn't play this week, Tahj Brooks would have to step up and play the RB2 role behind Chase Brown against a tough Houston defense on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joe Burrow (back) limited at practice again Thursday
items.desc: Joe Burrow (back) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Burrow was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday due to back soreness that he's battling. It looks like he's trending the right way for Week 2, however, as he was able to throw passes on Thursday after not doing so on Wednesday. His status should be closely monitored heading into the weekend, as if he playing at less than 100% against Houston's tough defense, that will have a negative impact on the outlook of Chase Brown, Ja'Marr Chase, and Tee Higgins for this week's game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Schultz (rest) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz (rest) returned to practice as a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran was back at practice on Thursday after getting Wednesday off as a rest day. He should be fully good to go for Week 2 and may be primed for more work than usual with Nico Collins (hamstring) trending towards being sidelined against the Bengals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Nico Collins (hamstring) officially did not take part in Houston's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Collins did not take part in Houston's practice on Thursday, which is no surprise after he was recently diagnosed with a Grade 1 hamstring strain. It looks likely that he will miss Sunday's game against the Bengals, and he could miss another week or two beyond that depending on how his recovery goes. If he misses time, fantasy managers should expect Jaylin Noel, Kayshon Boutte, and Dalton Schultz to all see more work in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (illness) off injury report for Week 2
items.desc: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (illness) is off of the injury report and will be good to go for Week 2's matchup against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: It was reported earlier in the week that Tracy is dealing with a serious case of the flu, but he seems to have gotten over it already, as he is no longer listed on the team's injury report and was a full go at practice on Thursday. He should continue to play his usual depth role in New York's backfield on Monday, though he doesn't carry any fantasy value at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) officially DNP Thursday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson (finger) was officially a non-participant on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Hendrickson was officially a non-participant on Thursday after not being spotted during the open portion of practice. It looks like he has a real chance to missing this week's game against New Orleans, which would be a significant hit to the defensive front and pass rush of Baltimore in Week 2.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) a limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) was a limited participant again on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Madubuike will be available to play for the Ravens this weekend, as he has participated at both of their practices so far this week. His presence will be an immense help for their defensive front, which will be all the more necessary if Trey Hendrickson (finger) is ruled out for this matchup against the Saints.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Devontez Walker (groin) practices in full again Thursday
items.desc: Devontez Walker (groin) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
items.impact: Walker was again a full participant at practice on Thursday, which means that he will almost certainly be available to make his season debut on Sunday. He will likely play a substantial role against the Saints with Zay Flowers (hamstring) trending towards being sidelined for that game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Teddye Buchanan (knee) limited Thursday
items.desc: Teddye Buchanan (knee) was limited at Thursday's practice.
items.impact: Buchanan participated in another practice on Thursday, which gives him a good chance to suit up and play in Week 2. Baltimore's defense will need all the help they can get in a matchup against a potent New Orleans offense on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) did not take part at Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Simpson was yet again a non-participant at practice on Thursday. He has a real chance of missing Sunday's game against the Saints, which would especially have a negative impact on Baltimore's offense if they are also without Ronnie Stanley (toe) for this matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (toe) missed another practice for the Ravens on Thursday.
items.impact: The Ravens are at risk of their star left tackle sitting out in Week 2, as he has missed multiple practices this week due to a toe injury. We should get an official injury designation for him sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Zay Flowers (hamstring) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The Ravens may be without their star wide receiver for Week 2, as he has not been able to take part in either of Baltimore's practices so far this week. If he is sidelined, fantasy managers should expect Devontez Walker and Rashod Bateman to be two of the biggest beneficiaries of his absence from a fantasy perspective.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Greg Newsome II (rib) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Greg Newsome II (rib) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: New York currently has three of their key defensive backs listed on their injury report, including Newsome, who was limited at Thursday's practice due to a rib injury. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 2, however, which is great news for the team after he had a nice showing against the Cowboys in the season opener last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) without injury designation for Week 2
items.desc: Malik Nabers (knee) is without an injury designation heading into Week 2.
items.impact: Nabers told reporters that he is dealing with some minor soreness following his return to the field last week, but it doesn't seem to be anything to be concerned about, as he is not listed on the team's injury report at all heading into Week 2 and practiced in full on Thursday. He should be good to go this week and projects to be a great fantasy option for however long as he stays healthy and on the field this season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deonte Banks (calf) considered limited Thursday
items.desc: Deonte Banks (calf) was considered a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Banks is one of several New York defenders dealing with an injury right now. His calf injury doesn't seem particularly serious, but it's worth keeping an eye on their injury report ahead of a tough Monday night matchup against the Rams, as the momentum their defense picked up last week could be halted by just one or two key absences in their secondary this week against a potent offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Paulson Adebo (knee) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Paulson Adebo (knee) missed practice for the Giants on Thursday.
items.impact: A knee injury left the veteran sidelined from practice on Thursday. The Giants have several injured players in their secondary right now, so their defense may be operating at less than full strength against the Rams this week if one or multiple of their key defenders are sidelined.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (ankle) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The Giants limited Thomas' workload on Thursday due to an ankle issue, and he was officially considered a limited participant at practice. It doesn't seem like this will affect his availability for Week 2, which is good considering how significant he is to a New York offense that looked great in the season opener last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cameron Jordan (hamstring) limited Thursday
items.desc: Cameron Jordan (hamstring) was a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Jordan was able to practice in a limited fashion again on Thursday, making him likely to make his season debut against the Ravens on Sunday. New Orleans' defense will see a boost when they get the veteran back on their defensive front.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Juwan Johnson (illness) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Juwan Johnson (illness) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Johnson was back at practice on Thursday after being absent from practice on Wednesday due to an illness of some kind. He should be fully good to go for Sunday's game against the Ravens, and fantasy managers should continue to view him as a viable starter for the foreseeable future, especially with Chris Olave (hamstring) now popping up on the injury report and at risk of missing a bit of time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alvin Kamara (knee) practices in full again Thursday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (knee) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran running back was again a full participant at practice on Thursday, making him very likely to play in Sunday's game against Baltimore. His expected presence will likely take some work away from both Kendre Miller and Travis Etienne Jr. moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chase Young (calf) added to injury report Thursday
items.desc: Chase Young (calf) has been added to the injury report as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran popped up on Thursday's injury report due to a new calf issue of some kind. If it leaves him sidelined this week, New Orleans' defense will have a gap in their defensive front in what projects to be a tough matchup against the Ravens on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Olave (hamstring) limited at practice on Thursday
items.desc: Chris Olave (hamstring) has been added to the injury report and was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Olave is a new addition to New Orleans' injury report, being listed with a hamstring injury that left him limited at the team's practice on Thursday. The exact nature and severity of this injury is unclear at this point, so fantasy managers should pay close attention to updates about his health over the next day or two to see if this is minor injury maintenance or if he is dealing with a real issue that will threaten his availability for Week 2's matchup against the Ravens on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carlton Davis III (neck) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Carlton Davis III (neck) was absent from New England's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Thursday was the second-straight practice that Davis missed due to a neck injury, and it looks like it may leave him sidelined for Sunday's game against the Steelers. Aaron Rodgers and Co. will have an easier time if the Patriots are down one of their starting cornerbacks this weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Henderson was able to log a second-straight full practice session on Thursday. He seems almost certain to play without any real limitations this week, as he also told reporters that he is ready to go for Sunday's game. His return to the lineup will mean less work for Rhamondre Stenson moving forward, but they could both be worthwhile starters on any given week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dre'Mont Jones (foot) limited Thursday
items.desc: Dre'Mont Jones (foot) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: New England's top pass rusher continues to deal with injury. Jones has been limited at practice all week due to a foot injury, and it's unclear if it will affect his availability for Sunday's game. Their pass rush will be noticeably weaker if he is off of the field against the Steelers this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (conditioning/back) limited Thursday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (conditioning/back) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Porter's status for Week 2 remains up in the air at this point. He is still dealing with a minor back issue, and the team is also trying to get his conditioning up to par after he missed the season opener. Pittsburgh's defense will greatly benefit is he is available to make his season debut this week against the Patriots, but it's unclear whether or not that will be the case at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darnell Washington (personal) still absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Darnell Washington (personal) was again absent from Pittsburgh's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The young tight end is still dealing with some kind of a personal issue. He has yet to practice this week, but he may very well still be able to suit up for Sunday's game. We should get more concrete information about his status after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) officially DNP Thursday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) officially didn't practice for the Steelers on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout was officially a non-participant for the Steelers on Thursday after being added to their injury report on Wednesday due to a foot issue of some kind. It looks like a real threat to his Week 2 availability, and fantasy managers should expect TE Pat Freiermuth to see more work if Pittman is sidelined against New England.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end missed another practice session on Thursday due to his hamstring injury, and it looks likely to leave him sidelined for Sunday's game against Dallas. Fantasy managers should expect John Bates to get more work if Okonkwo is ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylin Lane (groin) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Jaylin Lane (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday
items.impact: The second-year wideout was limited at practice again on Thursday. His groin injury isn't serious at this point, but there's always the possibility that the team will let him sit out for a game in order to rest and recover. His status doesn't carry much weight for fantasy purposes at this point, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Odafe Oweh (calf) limited Thursday
items.desc: Odafe Oweh (calf) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, the Commanders continue to limit Oweh's workload and left him limited at practice on Thursday. He should be able to play through it in Week 2, however, assuming he suffers no setbacks between now and then.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Daron Payne (knee) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Daron Payne (knee) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Payne was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being limited by a knee injury at practice on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Week 2 and will continue to be an anchor for Washington's defensive front in a tough matchup against the Cowboys.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: K'Lavon Chaisson (knee) still limited Thursday
items.desc: K'Lavon Chaisson (knee) was still limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran edge rusher remained limited for another practice on Thursday, as the team continues to cap his workload on account of his knee injury. It looks like he is trending towards playing this week, but it remains to be seen if he will have any limitations or not.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Frankie Luvu (groin) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Frankie Luvu (groin) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Chances are that Luvu will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, since he has yet to practice for the Commanders this week. He may have a chance to play if he returns to practice on Friday, but that seems more and more like a long shot.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cedric Gray (concussion) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Cedric Gray (concussion) practiced in full for the Titans on Thursday.
items.impact: Gray seems to be good to go for Week 2 and will likely officially clear the NFL's concussion protocols any day now. His presence will be nice Tennessee's defense ahead of a difficult matchup against Jalen Hurts and the Eagles on Sunday.
